meta.themes: Cloud Agents Mature, Governed Enterprise AI, Agentic Infrastructure Expands, Safety and Policy Pressure Rise

news.title: OpenAI launched a managed Agents API built on the Codex harness
news.summary: OpenAI released the Agents API in public beta, letting developers run long-lived cloud agents through a single API while choosing an OpenAI-hosted sandbox, their own infrastructure, or a sandbox partner for execution.

news.title: Meta introduced Muse as a personal agent that acts across apps
news.summary: Meta launched Muse in the United States as a personal agent that can pursue tasks through its own browser inside a dedicated secure virtual machine, with users controlling which services and data it can access.

news.title: OpenAI brought governed data analysis and dashboards to ChatGPT Work
news.summary: OpenAI's new Data agent connects ChatGPT Work to approved databases, files, and BI tools so employees can investigate business questions and build dashboards while queries retain existing table, row, and column permissions.

news.title: Google Cloud packaged skills and MCP grounding into a coding-agent plugin
news.summary: Google Cloud released a developer plugin that bundles operational skills, tool configuration, and its Developer Knowledge MCP server under the open Agent Plugins specification for portable use across coding agents.

news.title: Atlassian added governed agent loops to its software delivery stack
news.summary: Atlassian announced context controls, code-aware agent loops, standards and AI review features, plus usage and value dashboards designed to keep developers in control while agents execute work across the software lifecycle.

news.title: Google launched a native Gemini app for Windows
news.summary: Google released Gemini for Windows with an Alt + Space shortcut, a dedicated workspace for longer tasks, Google app connections, and access to the Gemini Spark personal agent from the desktop.

news.title: Anthropic detailed how malicious actors are shifting from prompts to autonomous workflows
news.summary: Anthropic's September threat report described disrupted campaigns involving automated exploit research, influence operations, credential theft, model distillation, and other misuse as agentic systems reduced the expertise and time required by attackers.

news.title: Microsoft framed agent governance as a cost and ROI control system
news.summary: Microsoft outlined how Foundry Control Plane, Azure Policy, Defender, Purview, cost allocation, budgets, and lifecycle controls can give enterprises a governed operating view of agent ownership, access, usage, and spend.

news.title: AI disruption fears pushed major software stocks lower
news.summary: Salesforce and Intuit fell about 4%, ServiceNow lost 5%, and the S&P software and services index declined 1.4% as investors renewed bets that newer AI systems could displace specialized software products.

news.title: Nvidia partners targeted a 2-gigawatt Australian AI buildout
news.summary: Nvidia said eight Australian cloud and data-center partners plan to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of DSX-based AI factory capacity by 2027, expanding local access to accelerated computing and Nemotron models.

news.title: Arm expanded its compute stack for agentic AI from edge to cloud
news.summary: Arm introduced an AI-native mobile platform, AGI CPU and Neoverse CSS N4 cloud infrastructure, physical-AI ecosystem work, and an AI Portal intended to help developers and agents find optimized models and software.

news.title: U.S. agencies accused Chinese AI firms of industrial-scale model distillation
news.summary: A joint FBI, NSA, and CISA advisory accused DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and Z.ai of extracting capabilities from U.S. frontier models since at least 2024, while China's Commerce Ministry rejected the claims.
